default_behavior: decompose every non-trivial request; use one local task for small work when one task profile and focused validation are sufficient
small_task_behavior: one local task with compact small-task evidence; load the full decomposition policy only when an expansion trigger fires
decomposition_order: classify current user authorization allowed actions task profile task scale changed facts project areas and risk
split by changed fact canonical owner contract area dependency validation need and support-surface synchronization
assign exactly one implementation level to each task
select primary worker suggestion-only or blocked executor
attach bounded context non-goals allowed files validation and acceptance criteria
primary assistant reconciles results changed facts approvals validation documentation diagrams support information and residual risk

levels.name: read-only-analysis
use_when: inspection evidence collection issue review status recommendations
levels.quality_gate: report evidence uncertainty and no file changes

levels.name: documentation-or-support-update
use_when: bounded docs adapter prompts gates diagrams or generated-reference sync for already owned facts
levels.quality_gate: no invented facts and canonical owner reconciliation required

levels.name: tests-or-validation
use_when: test checker fixture validation execution or failure evidence
levels.quality_gate: do not change expectations to hide defects or weaken the selected contract

levels.name: bounded-implementation
use_when: settled design bounded code change known owner objective validation
levels.quality_gate: validate locally and update required companion surfaces

levels.name: coherent-change-package
use_when: code tests docs diagrams support information approvals or multiple surfaces must move together
levels.quality_gate: global logical integrity review over the combined repair set

levels.name: architecture-or-business-decision
use_when: accepted behavior architecture data ownership source-of-truth public contract or security decision
levels.quality_gate: accepted facts require target decision owner and approval before implementation

levels.name: protected-external-or-publication-action
use_when: commit push deploy destructive live external credential permission spend production dependency migration or release
levels.quality_gate: recheck newest user authorization and scoped approval immediately before action

selection_order: primary for semantic decision approval conflict final convergence and protected actions
verified worker only for bounded ready subtasks whose level and role allow it
suggestion-only when capability exists conceptually but execution is unavailable or not trusted
blocked when required owner authorization approval validation or context is missing
executor_selection.fallback: continue with primary execution or ask the user when capability authorization approval or validation is unresolved

final_evidence: decomposition plan ID and policy revision
task IDs implementation levels dependencies and executor decisions
context selected and intentionally omitted per task
worker packet and result IDs when delegation was used
validation acceptance and primary convergence result
escalations residual risk and cost or latency measurement only when captured
review_triggers: task routing caused repeated context overuse
delegated work caused rework validation failure or scope drift
project areas owners validation commands or support relationships changed
assistant capability or model availability changed
